tools.name: synthesize_sql_query
tools.description: Translates natural language questions into dialect-accurate, optimized SQL SELECT queries with schema awareness and safety checks. Use when generating reporting queries or automated data analytics pipelines; for analyzing SQL execution performance and EXPLAIN plans, use analyze_query_plan instead. S

Use when auditing dynamic query parameters or untrusted user input before database execution; for sanitizing query strings for telemetry logging, use sanitize_sql_telem

tools.name: analyze_query_plan
tools.description: Analyzes SQL EXPLAIN execution plans to detect sequential table scans, high-cost cartesian joins, and buffer memory bottlenecks. Use when diagnosing slow queries, optimizing database performance, or evaluating query cost; for getting index recommendations, use recommend_database_indexes instead. Sta

tools.name: detect_breaking_migrations
tools.description: Compares source and target DDL schemas to identify breaking changes, destructive column drops, and lock-inducing mutations. Use when verifying CI/CD migration scripts before production deployment to prevent downtime; for verifying relational normal form, use validate_schema_normalization instead. St

tools.name: transpile_sql_dialect
tools.description: Transpiles SQL queries and DDL schemas across PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite dialects, rewriting functions and syntax quirks. Use when migrating application queries across database backends or testing against in-memory SQLite; for generating new queries from natural language, use synthesize_sql_query

tools.description: Audits database schemas for third normal form (3NF) compliance, transitive dependencies, and missing foreign key constraints. tools.name: sanitize_sql_telemetry
tools.description: Masks PII, financial values, and credential literals from raw SQL query logs and slow-query dumps before telemetry storage. tools.name: synthesize_seed_fixtures
tools.description: Generates deterministic relational test seed fixtures respecting foreign key constraints, unique indexes, and data bounds. tools.name: calculate_pool_headroom
tools.description: Calculates optimal connection pool sizing, idle timeouts, and client headroom based on server RAM and concurrency profile. Use when sizing PgBouncer, HikariCP, or Prisma connection pools to avoid server out-of-memory crashes; for checking transaction isolation hazards, use audit_transaction_isolatio

tools.name: audit_transaction_isolation

Use when scaffolding application models, generating TypeScript data layers, or synchronizing schemas; for translating raw SQL across dialects, use transpile_sql_dialect instead.
